name: application-toggle-group
title: Toggle Group
description: Connected group of toggle buttons for single- or multi-select choices, driven by a typed items array and a controlled value.
useWhen: Letting a user pick one option from a small connected set, such as text alignment or a calendar view.
Letting a user toggle several independent options at once, such as bold/italic/underline formatting.
You want a typed items array and controlled value/values instead of hand-editing a row of buttons.
avoidWhen: There are more than five or six options — use a select or dropdown menu instead.
The choice navigates to a different view entirely — use tabs instead of a toggle group.
Only a single boolean option exists — use a switch or checkbox instead.
responsiveBehavior: The group sizes to its content and does not wrap; place it in a flex or grid container to control alignment at each breakpoint.
accessibility: The container carries role='group' with an aria-label describing the group's purpose.
Each button carries aria-pressed reflecting its selected state, not color alone.
Icon-only buttons carry an aria-label; buttons with visible text do not duplicate it.

variants.title: Single-select (icon)
variants.description: Connected single-select segmented control with icon buttons, such as text alignment.
accessibility: The selected button is distinguished by a background, ring, and aria-pressed, not color alone.

variants.title: Single-select (icon, Dark)
variants.description: Single-select icon segmented control adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Selected and unselected button contrast must meet WCAG AA on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Multi-select (formatting)
variants.description: Connected multi-select toggle group, such as bold/italic/underline text formatting, where each button toggles independently.
accessibility: Each button's aria-pressed state is independent so screen readers announce multiple active options correctly.

variants.title: Multi-select (formatting, Dark)
variants.description: Multi-select formatting toggle group adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Active and inactive button contrast must meet WCAG AA on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Single-select (pill)
variants.description: Pill-shaped single-select toggle group for switching views, such as a Day/Week/Month calendar switcher.
accessibility: The selected pill is distinguished by a filled background and shadow, not color alone.

variants.title: Single-select (pill, Dark)
variants.description: Pill-shaped single-select toggle group adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Selected and unselected pill contrast must meet WCAG AA on dark backgrounds.
